meta.promptText: Which moisturizer should I buy for dry skin in Indian winters?

response.text:
For **dry skin during Indian winters**, I’d prioritize a richer moisturizer with **ceramides + glycerin/hyaluronic acid + emollients**. These help hydrate and strengthen the skin barrier, which tends to get weaker in cold, dry weather. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My top picks

### [Cetaphil DAM Daily Advance Ultra Hydrating Lotion]()
*₹208*

### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹266*

### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹422*

### [Minimalist Ceramide Barrier Repair Moisturizing Cream]()
*₹539*

**🥇 Best overall: Cetaphil DAM Daily Advance Ultra Hydrating Lotion**  
Especially good if your skin gets **very dry, tight or flaky** in winter. Cetaphil specifically recommends its richer moisturizers for winter dryness. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**💰 Best value: Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser**  
A good choice if you want a **lighter-feeling facial moisturizer** while still getting ceramide-based barrier support. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/10-best-barrier-repair-creams-for-indian-winters-that-truly-heal-dry-skin-10792239?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🧴 Best for very dry skin: CeraVe Moisturising Cream**  
A richer cream with **ceramides and hyaluronic acid**, suitable for both face and body. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/10-best-barrier-repair-creams-for-indian-winters-that-truly-heal-dry-skin-10792239?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🌿 Best if your skin is sensitive: Minimalist Ceramide Barrier Repair Moisturizing Cream**  
Worth considering if winter dryness comes with irritation or a compromised skin barrier.

**If I had to pick just one:** **Cetaphil DAM** for genuinely dry winter skin.

Tip: Apply moisturizer **within a few minutes of washing, while your skin is still slightly damp**. And use sunscreen during winter too. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget (e.g. ₹300/₹500/₹1000)** and whether your skin is **dry, very dry, sensitive, or acne-prone**, I can narrow it down to one.
